Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.wellplanning

Class WellboreThermalModel

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.wellplanning.WellboreThermalModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class WellboreThermalModel extends Object implements Serializable
Wellbore thermal model for producers and injectors using the Ramey (1962) relaxation-distance solution with the Hasan and Kabir (1994) transient time function for heat conduction in the formation.

For a linear geothermal profile T_f(z) = T_s + g z and a relaxation distance A (m) the flowing-fluid temperature is

  • production (fluid flows up from the inlet depth L): T(z) = T_f(z) + g A + (T_in - T_f(L) - g A) exp(-(L - z)/A)
  • injection (fluid flows down from the surface): T(z) = T_f(z) - g A + (T_in - T_f(0) + g A) exp(-z/A)

with A = w cp (k_e + r_to U f(t)) / (2 pi r_to U k_e). Joule-Thomson and friction heating are not included; use a NeqSim enthalpy flash for these effects. The shut-in method is a lumped single-exponential approximation. Validation is by analytic limits (zero and infinite rate) only.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim

    • overallHeatTransferCoefficient

      public static double overallHeatTransferCoefficient(double innerFilmCoefficient, double[] radii, double[] conductivities, int outerIndex)
      Computes the overall heat-transfer coefficient referenced to the tubing outer radius from a series of radial conduction layers.
      Parameters:
      innerFilmCoefficient - fluid-side film coefficient in W/(m2 K), at the tubing inner radius
      radii - increasing layer boundary radii in m, starting at the tubing inner radius (length n+1)
      conductivities - layer thermal conductivities in W/(m K) (length n), for example tubing wall, insulation, annulus fluid, casing and cement
      outerIndex - index into radii of the tubing outer radius used as reference
      Returns:
      overall coefficient in W/(m2 K) based on radii[outerIndex]
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if array lengths or radii are inconsistent

    • getShutInTimeConstant

    • shutInTemperatureK

      public double shutInTemperatureK(double depthM, double initialTemperatureK, double shutInTimeHours)
      Returns the shut-in temperature of the fluid at a depth after a given shut-in time.
      Parameters:
      depthM - true vertical depth in m
      initialTemperatureK - flowing temperature at the moment of shut-in in K
      shutInTimeHours - time since shut-in in hours
      Returns:

    • timeToReachTemperatureHours

      public double timeToReachTemperatureHours(double depthM, double initialTemperatureK, double thresholdTemperatureK)
      Returns the time for the shut-in fluid to cool to a threshold temperature, for example a hydrate formation temperature.
      Parameters:
      depthM - true vertical depth in m
      initialTemperatureK - flowing temperature at the moment of shut-in in K
      thresholdTemperatureK - threshold temperature in K
      Returns:
      cooldown time in hours; zero if already below the threshold and positive infinity if the formation temperature is above the threshold (never reached)
